title: Better Baby Villagers
description: Fixes the cut-off baby villagers in the new Minecraft update
body:
# Details A lightweight resource pack that improves the appearance of baby villagers by correcting nose length and visual proportions. Designed to stay true to vanilla while resolving the awkward “cut off” look introduced in newer versions. # Comparision
Click to see the Comparison! #### Vanilla ![Before](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c696b36b84fcca89f92d6b9f07100b3b934ad9ed_0.webp) #### Enhanced ![After](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2af8590b373e417c793f8f5a028d530f3e1c54d4_0.webp)
